main_text.p: tuta municipalia. Iacobi 6. Paral.6. statuto 92a & parlam. 11. statut. 47. Præsertim vero stat. 106. parl. 7. Iacobi 6, anno 1581. quibus expresse mandatur, supremarum curiarum judicibus, ut in omnibus causis quæ ad illa fora pertinent dijudicandis, intrepide procedant; easdemque sublata omni cunctatione definiant, latamque sententiam executioni mandent, non obstante quolibet Regis mandato aut rescripto in contrarium: nihilque quotidiana hujus praxi in curiis illis usitatius: nam nisi singula causarum genera ad proprium forum referantur, mera obtinebit ἀτελία, ac nisi curiis illis supremis libertas hæc illibata constet, sub umbra promovendi jus regale, regnaret injustitia: Quæ eum locum habeant in sæcularibus curiis; potiori jure synodo nationali legitime convocatæ & formatæ competunt; utpote cui, supremam potestatem controversias omnes ecclesiasticas determinandi afferant vel ipsi Hierarchici, Theologi videl. Magnæ Britanniæ ad Synodum Dordracenam deputati, in judicio suo de Remonstrantium protestatione: qua sententia non putabant se juri regio detrahere, aut Papatui in Synodi persona renovare, quæ opinionem hanc nunc modeste tuentibus atrociter objiciuntur, ab iis qui struunt de proprio calumnias innocentiæ; & quod nondum auf sunt Antiqui Papatus monstrum aperta facie omnibus adorandum reponere, sub velo supremorum Magistratuum obtrudunt, eorumque spiritu beftiam illam extrema spirantem, re-focillare, ejusque vulnera mortalia obligare, nequicquam fatagunt. Denique ad illud quo omnibus mandatur subscriptio fœderis & confessionis juxta sensum & Declarationem à Marchione Regis nomine publicatam, Respondent; Senfum illum non esse genuinum, sed confessioni affixum, contrarium publicæ professioni & praxi majorum Confessioni primi-

page.notes: Transcription is from a 16th–17th century Latin text with some Greek (ἀτελία is rendered from the scan's Greek word, which the scan shows as a short Greek form; treat as uncertain). Several words are blurred or partly obscured at the line ends and in the lower part of the page; "primi-" is a line-end hyphenated word continuing onto the next page. Letters with long s have been normalised to plain s per the rules. Some words may be misread; where I was not sure I should have marked them [?], and the lower lines near the bottom are particularly faint and should be checked against the scan.
